task.description:
Rework after FAIL of REQ-VALIDATOR (step 02, gate pass 1 of 3; read its result completely: 22 findings F1-F22 with fixes). New fact: ORCH wrote decisions/0084-picker-new-office-choices.md (what 0083 replaces in 0074, 0077, 0078 and the done criteria of REQ-057 and REQ-061, ten default choices, the owner's holds, the look at the reference product). Refer to 0084 instead of claiming that 0083 replaces anything (finding F5), keep decisions 0073 and 0074 in force except the two items named in 0084, and drop any claim that conflicts with it. Edit only docs/requirements.yaml and your handoff, and only the blocks of REQ-058, 059, 060?(no, never 060), 064, 065, 066, 067 and REQ-069...078 and the new ones from REQ-079 on.
Fix all blocking findings and take the Low ones that are cheap:
F1 split REQ-075 into independent requirements (new ids from REQ-079; proposed: the live receipt and "Enough" button; the result page; print and PDF-by-print; CSV and the formats module) with correct depends_on; F2 split REQ-073 (format; calculation; route summary and the stand edit and the reader of the new texts) or argue in the block why not; F3 split REQ-071 (the scene module; the start screen and shell) and re-point depends_on in REQ-066, 074, 078; F4 name the guard tests QS-3, QS-5, QS-8, QS-11, QS-12 and read QS-2, 4, 7, 9 against the new files, in one shared paragraph with a was→became table that keeps each ban's intent, placed in the first requirement that breaks them and referenced by the others; F6 align the dates and times in REQ-066 with Kazakhstan format (26.10.2026, Astana UTC+5) as in REQ-075 and 078; F7 add to REQ-077 the route that delivers the shared public modules (a closed name list) and a criterion, and define the source of the scene's texts; F8 closed lists of word forms per language for the banned words, tested against real text (not open "и подобное"); F9 align the three criteria about `https?://` in public/ (REQ-076 adds the one wa.me address): say precisely what stays banned and where the single allowed place is; F10 name the stand per acceptance step (the REQ-070 tenants are the new two, the old two stay /2) and align contact_fields of the agency tenant between REQ-070 and REQ-076; F11 add a criterion for simultaneous requests against the hourly cap, the duplicate rule and number uniqueness (or state the accepted behaviour); F12 define the `total` rule for conditions on finally hidden questions and for "Не знаю" on a controlling question, add a test file with a conditional dependency; F13 complete depends_on; F14 tag "?" vs tag rule, "max not below" wording, question ids; F15 declare picker-demo-v3.test.js and picker-format.test.js as created by the work; F16 wrong criterion number for contrast; F17 fallback mark length and astral letters; F18 ISS-0077 items 17(a), 15; F19 REQ-062/063 links to api/result; F20 window title and the stale sentence in REQ-067; F21 move screen-level choices out of the descriptions if cheap; F22 the caption on the public scene ("the picture shows the stage, not people's movements") also on the scene where staff look busy.
Keep the build order and update it (one visible result per run); recompute depends_on after the splits; the holds of 0084 item 4 stay as an explicit sentence in REQ-059, 076 and the whatsapp field of REQ-069. before_copy for every edited pending block as before (base tag base/DESIGN0083-20261026-01 exists; for blocks edited in step 01 give the step-01 version too). Questions for the owner stay as questions. No code. No machine paths or other projects' names. Close your handoff with the list of ids written or changed, a table "finding → what you did", the updated order, and open questions.

REQ-066 time format now = function of REQ-079 (Astana UTC+5, '21.10.2026, 08:33 . Astana, UTC+5'); criterion 1 literals rewritten and run under two TZ values; depends_on + REQ-079.

REQ-077: route GET /b/<code>/shared/<name> with a closed name list (one constant, compared to the design's literal), new paragraph 'Common modules' and new criterion 9 (everything outside the list, texts.js, traversal and case variants give the same 404; the list is closed under imports; no key strings of other functions). Source of scene texts: the scene module has no words, the caller passes them (REQ-071 criterion 5 + REQ-078: board_ keys in board-texts.js, three language names compared with texts.js by the test, no import). Language list no longer shared.

Closed form lists per language for guarantee, free, minutes, 100 percent, price and days, typical variant, in one paragraph of REQ-071; comparison by whole word (letters and digits, case-insensitive); open 'and similar' of REQ-074 criterion 9 removed; the rule is tested on real text (0 hits on texts.js and the two /2 tenants, hits on 12 artificial violations, silence on 6 look-alike words) - the lists were also run by me outside the project on the real files with the same result. Test file tools/test/picker-words.test.js + helper named as created by REQ-071.

All standing https greps in public/ are written with the filter grep -v 'https://wa[.]me/' (REQ-074, 075, 080, 081, 082), so they are true before and after REQ-076; REQ-076 criterion 7 keeps 'exactly one line' and says so in the description. Checked the pairs for Math.random, window.open, fetch(, alert/confirm/prompt, innerHTML, Sai, pixel-office, board: no other conflicting pair.

Every acceptance step names its stand (REQ-070 v3 folder for stock/agency; REQ-056 demo-tenants folder for uchet-pro/svet-marketing as a second serve) in REQ-059, 066, 071, 075, 076, 080, 081, 082, 085. contact_fields: stock [phone, telegram], agency [phone] in REQ-070 (description and criterion 1) = REQ-076.

REQ-059: lead acceptance is one indivisible operation per tenant inside the server process (caps, duplicate, number, write, progress record under one lock); explicit assumption: one serve process per data folder; new criterion 11 (20 concurrent requests at one free place -> exactly one accepted; duplicates; 500 concurrent with a colliding number source gives 500 distinct numbers; rejected request leaves no file, no record, no temp file).

Proposal: ask both at once; the order puts all visible results of the visitor's journey up to the details section (steps 1-15) before the hold. The REQ-078 acceptance does not need REQ-076 (requests by curl), so the hold does not spread there beyond REQ-059.

A rule that is bigger than one requirement: null in the answers set means 'I do not know' and closes the question (its dependants are finally hidden; a missing key does not close it). It is written in REQ-072 and used by REQ-074, 075, 059, 076, 084. Proposal for decisions/0084 (or a new record): one line stating this rule, because REQ-072 describes a function and the page, the server routes and the lead file all depend on the same convention (Q12).

Recommended: yes (the visitor sees busy staff that are not real; the 'My request' caption already says the same). It costs one key and one criterion.
